description: Get the company profile by its company id.

company_id.description: The unique id of the company.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the company object (id, name, ein, entity_type, company_status, primary_address, pay_schedule, currency); on failure (company not found), output contains an error message.

description: List all employees for a company, each enriched with its current compensation record.

company_id.description: The unique id of the company.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of employee objects each including a 'compensation' field; on failure (company not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single employee by id, enriched with its current compensation record.

employee_id.description: The unique id of the employee.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the employee object including a 'compensation' field; on failure (employee not found), output contains an error message.

description: List payrolls for a company, optionally filtered by processed state.

company_id.description: The unique id of the company.

processed.description: Optional processed flag; when set, only payrolls matching this processed state are returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of payroll objects; on failure (company not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single payroll by its payroll id.

payroll_id.description: The unique id of the payroll.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the payroll object; on failure (payroll not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new (unprocessed) payroll for a company over a pay period.

company_id.description: The unique id of the company the payroll belongs to.

pay_period_start.description: The pay period start date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format (required).

pay_period_end.description: The pay period end date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format (required).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created payroll object; on failure (company not found, or missing pay period dates), output contains an error message.

description: Submit (process) a payroll, computing gross and net pay from active employee compensation.

payroll_id.description: The unique id of the payroll to submit.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the processed payroll object with computed gross_pay and net_pay; on failure (payroll not found or already processed), output contains an error message.

description: List all contractors for a company.

company_id.description: The unique id of the company.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of contractor objects; on failure (company not found), output contains an error message.
